column1: # Source: the RN26038 LIMS sample sheet (project RN26038, plate eASF_A07136,
# container 27-960439), supplied by the user 2026-07-27. NOTHING in
# data/flashseq/ carries this mapping -- the run directory, the samplesheet.csv
# and the FASTQ filenames all know the libraries only as ZHA8833A1..A10. Without
# this file the run looks like ten comparable samples, which it is not.
# The run is an input-amount titration in duplicate. input_pg is the input
# amount normalised to picograms so it can be used as a numeric x-axis; a
# mammalian cell carries ~10-30 pg of total RNA, so the 30 pg rung is the
# single-cell-equivalent one and is the rung that matters for the VASA-seq
# well is the position on plate eASF_A07136 and is NOT decoration: the human
# CALB1 contamination reported in README.md tracks wells G:1/H:1, not input
# amount, and that is only visible if the well is carried through the analysis.
